headline: Software engineer
tagline: Backend systems, payments, and the unglamorous work that keeps products running.
aboutText:
I build and maintain backend systems for fintech and e-commerce teams.

Most of my work is in Go and TypeScript: payment flows, reconciliation jobs, and the APIs that sit between them. I care about clear failure modes, useful logs, and tests that catch real problems.

Outside work I maintain a small open-source library for webhook retries and write occasionally about production incidents.

work.description: Own the payments API and reconciliation pipeline processing about ₱2B monthly.
Built order and inventory services for a nationwide sari-sari store platform.
Worked across a Go monolith and the React admin tools around it.

contactIntro: Email is the best way to reach me.
